title: The Central Velocity Gradient—surface Brightness Relation and the Baryonic Tully—Fisher Relation in Two-Parameter Constant-Lagrangian Fits to Sparc
summary: Lelli, Fraternali & Verheijen (2013) showed that the central circular-velocity gradient of disc galaxies, d_R V(0), scales with the central surface brightness as d_R V(0) ∝ Iu2080^0.55. This is close to the Iu2080^1/2 expected when the central dynamical density tracks the central stellar density. We examine how this relation, together with the baryonic Tully—Fisher relation (BTFR), appears in the two parameters (M, R) of the constant-Lagrangian (CL) rotation-curve model fitted to 175 SPARC galaxies.The inner branch of the CL curve is that of a homogeneous sphere to within the small Hubble…

review.reason: Fits a constant-Lagrangian rotation-curve model to SPARC galaxies and checks the baryonic Tully-Fisher relation.
